slots.title: A stolen iPhone, $14,000 in losses and London's crypto theft problem
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Two strangers befriended Magnus Ahmad outside a London bar. Hours later, thieves had emptied his crypto wallets, accessed his bank accounts and disabled his laptop.

slots.title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of stolen crypto after massive $6.3 billion breach
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Binance is absorbing all losses through corporate funds, futures reserves, and SAFU, keeping user balances intact.

slots.title: Bitcoin's white paper turns 18, and small businesses are still paying for the bailouts it answered
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Eighteen years after Satoshi published the Bitcoin white paper, business owners are still covering the cost of a system built on bailouts, and they can protect part of their surplus by keeping it in bitcoin, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

slots.title: OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: OpenAI’s latest funding round doesn't seem to be living up to expectations.

slots.title: Traders are already placing leveraged bets on Anthropic’s IPO using crypto contracts
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Trade.xyz’s new ANT contract fell about 20% in its first hour on Hyperliquid. There are no shares behind it, and U.S. traders are locked out.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Institutions embrace crypto staking despite shrinking yields
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Easier access and growing familiarity are encouraging investors to stake their tokens, while falling rewards and withdrawal delays test the economics.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
